messages.text: The BS-1 is off sale right now while BitFortun fixes its firmware. The closest thing you can get today is the Hammer BC04, 6 TH/s at $239, shipping now. Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?
Searched the catalog · Hammer BC04 6 TH/s miner

For a first miner the BC04 is the one I'd point you at: $239, 6 TH/s, about 100W, so roughly $12 a month in power at 16¢. It's in stock and ships in about 5 days.

It draws on a real Bitcoin block every ten minutes, forever, and you learn how pools and wallets actually work. Want me to set it up?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Bitfortun BS-1 numbers for where you live.
